name: We Love Scripture
description: Resources for friends who want to know God more in Scripture, and each other more in friendship: study guides, articles, videos and a podcast.
guideHowTo: Gather with friends. Read the passage out loud, taking turns. Answer the questions to each other, not to the guide. End by praying for one another.
footerNote: Scripture quotations are from the King James Version, which is in the public domain.
